question: The Airavatesvara Temple in Tamil Nadu was built by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rajaraja Chola II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• ​Airavatesvara Temple is a Hindu temple of Dravidian architecture located in Kumbakonam, Thanjavur District in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The temple was built by King Rajaraja Chola II.
 
• This temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, along with the Thanjavur Temple, and the Gangaikondacholisvaram Temple.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Rajaraja Chola I**, on the other hand, is known for building the Brihadeeswara Temple in Thanjavur, another UNESCO World Heritage Site. This temple is considered one of the greatest achievements of the Chola dynasty and is known for its towering vimana (tower).
 
• **Maharaja Pratap Singh **was a ruler of the kingdom of Jaipur in Rajasthan. He is known for building several palaces and forts in the region, including the famous Hawa Mahal in Jaipur.
 
• ** Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II** was also a ruler of Jaipur and is known for his contributions to astronomy and mathematics. He built several observatories, including the Jantar Mantar in Jaipur, which is still in use today.
